text.en: Owners of rabbits, guinea pigs, and small pets express strong confidence in the care provided at the hotel. Multiple reviews mention that bunnies and guinea pigs return home relaxed, clean, and happy after their stays. Although one owner shared a sad loss involving an unwell hamster, the prevailing sentiment highlights attentive small animal welfare.

Pet parents regularly compliment Mike and Alison for their warmth, reliability, and specialist understanding of rabbit care. Clients appreciate the couple's flexibility during family emergencies and their willingness to provide reassurance. Reviewers describe the hosts as genuine animal lovers who maintain safe, calm routines for all boarding guests.

title.en: Overall boarding satisfaction with isolated concern

text.en: The majority of pet owners report excellent boarding outcomes, citing regular photo updates and peaceful stays that allow families to travel worry-free. Alongside consistent praise for clean hutches and outdoor runs, feedback includes one distressing outcome where a small pet passed away post-stay, making overall results broadly positive yet mixed.

q.en: What small animals can board at Furry Friends Hotel?

a.en: The hotel accommodates rabbits, guinea pigs, tortoises, and small caged pets in purpose-built indoor and outdoor hutches.

q.en: Do owners receive updates while their pets are boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention receiving photo updates and messages showing their pets relaxing and enjoying outdoor runs.

q.en: Are exercise areas available for boarding rabbits?

a.en: Yes, the facility provides secure runs allowing rabbits and small pets to exercise outside in appropriate weather.

q.en: What are the standard collection and drop-off times?

a.en: The hotel is open for drop-off and collection Monday to Saturday from 10:00am to 4:00pm, remaining closed on Sundays.
